name: duckie-pomdp-f10-sac-v1
purpose: F10 local SAC training with frozen YOLO/F9c perception and online W&B telemetry

install_phases.reason: Warm-reuse the validated F8/F9 CUDA and YOLO stack; no package operation
Pin experiment telemetry without changing Torch or simulator dependencies

validation.import_smoke: python -c "import gym, numpy, torch, ultralytics, wandb; print(numpy.__version__, torch.__version__, ultralytics.__version__, wandb.__version__)"
validation.cuda_witness: python -c "import torch; torch.manual_seed(10000); x=torch.randn(8,8,device='cuda'); print('F10_WITNESS', tuple((x@x).shape), float((x@x).sum()), torch.cuda.get_device_name())"
